geography.text: In the literature source used, the numbers for process emissions have been taken from the manufacture of dimetylerephthalate, as an approximation. Data concerning consumption of raw materials and energy base on information provided by a coating manufacturing company (Akzo). It is not known how representative are these values for the European butyl acrylat industry
